meta.name: caption-burn
meta.description: Burned-in captions for a finished vertical video, three kinds. transcribe.py gets word timings from the video's own audio through the GooseWorks proxy (fal Whisper, bills the Ads agent, cents); captions.py burns one to three words at a time with Pillow + ffmpeg (no libass needed), either pinned to a split-screen seam (plate 25% above / 75% below) or at a fixed height, in a plate, outline or one-word serif style, with an optional red hook card; plates.py burns per-beat caption blocks (black, one union silhouette, placed in the emptiest band) for formats with no voice. The last caption (the CTA) holds to the final frame. Use as the last step of any video ad.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给成片竖版视频烧上字幕,可按分屏接缝或固定高度排版,还能加红色钩子卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做竖版视频广告,想给已剪好的成片加上烧录字幕
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're finishing a vertical video ad and need burned-in captions.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会给已完成的竖版视频烧录字幕：从视频自身音频取词级时间，一次烧 1–3 个词（贴接缝或固定高度、plate 或 outline 样式），也能给无旁白的视频烧黑色字幕块，最后一条 CTA 保持到最后一帧。
howto.when: 视频广告制作流程的最后一步：成片已就绪、要烧入字幕时接管；无旁白的片子改用 plates.py 烧字幕块。

say.text: 用 transcribe.py 把 reel.mp4 转成词级时间文件
say.note: 走 GooseWorks 代理，按分计费

say.text: 给没有旁白的 walk.mp4 按节拍烧上黑色字幕块

howto.what_en: Claude burns captions into a finished vertical video. Word timings come from the video's own audio; 1–3 words burn at a time in plate or outline style; no-voice formats get caption blocks; the last CTA caption holds to the final frame.
howto.when_en: Use as the last step of any video ad: once the video is finished, when you want burned-in captions, word timings, or black caption blocks for a no-voice cut.

say_en.text: Transcribe reel.mp4 into a word-timing file.
say_en.note: Goes through the proxy; billed in cents.

say_en.text: Burn plate-style captions onto reel.mp4 using the aligned cutlist.
say_en.note: Writes final.mp4; the last caption holds.

say_en.text: Burn black caption blocks per beat onto the no-voice walk.mp4.
